Unfortunately, once an order has shipped, we're no longer able to make address changes on our end. Per our shipping policy (kb/02-shipping-policy.md), **address changes are only possible before the order ships**. After shipment, you'll need to **contact the carrier directly** to request a delivery address update.

Here are a few tips to help:
- Check your shipping confirmation email for the carrier name and tracking number.
- Visit the carrier's website (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS) and use their address correction or delivery management tools — many carriers allow you to redirect a package while it's in transit.

If you run into any trouble with the carrier, feel free to reach back out and we'll do our best to assist!
